title: ImmersiveCinematics
description: Add cinematic cutscenes to your modpack — no command blocks required. JSON scripting, 14 trigger types, and an in-game timeline editor.
body:
## What Is It?

ImmersiveCinematics lets you add cinematic cutscenes to your modpack — no command blocks, no redstone, no compromise. Write a JSON script or use the built-in timeline editor, and the server-side trigger system plays them automatically when conditions are met.ImmersiveCinematics让你添加过场动画到你的modpack &mdash；没有命令块，没有红石，没有妥协。编写JSON脚本或使用内置的时间轴编辑器，服务器端触发系统在满足条件时自动播放它们。

---

## Features

### Cutscene System

- **6-DOF Camera** — position, yaw, pitch, roll, FOV, zoom, DOF
- **Keyframe Animation** + **Bezier curves** with arc-length parametrization for smooth motion
- **Multi-track timeline** — Camera, Letterbox, Audio, Event, Mod Event
- **Relative / absolute** positioning, looping, infinite duration
- **Widescreen letterbox bars** (2.35:1) with fade in/out
- **Morph transitions** between shots

### Trigger System (Server-Side)

14 trigger types — scripts fire automatically when conditions are met:14种触发类型&mdash；脚本在满足条件时自动触发：

login · location (point+radius / cuboid) · advancement · biome · dimension_change · entity_kill · interact · item_craft · item_use · inventory · structure · gamestage · custom · command登录&中点；位置（点半径/长方体）&中点；进度&中点；生物群落&中点；维度&变化&中点；实体&杀戮&中点；互动&中点；item_craft &中点；item_use &中点；库存&中点；结构&中点；游戏阶段&中点；自定义&中点；命令

- OR/AND logic and wildcard matching—OR/AND逻辑和通配符匹配
- Single-fire or repeatable, with configurable delay-单火或可重复，可配置延迟
- Per-player state persistence (SNBT)-每个玩家的状态持久化（SNBT）

### Runtime Control   ###运行时控制

- **18 behavior flags** — skippable, interruptible, hold-at-end, keyboard/mouse/mob-AI blocking, 7 independent HUD toggles, arm hiding, view-bob suppression, player model rendering, pause-when-paused- **18个行为标志**可跳过，可中断，保持在末端，键盘/鼠标/暴徒ai阻塞，7个独立的HUD切换，手臂隐藏，视图bob抑制，玩家模型渲染，暂停时暂停
- **Script queuing and preemption**- **脚本排队和抢占**
- **Multiplayer** — full script tracking, completion sync, skip voting- **多人游戏**完整的脚本跟踪，完成同步，跳过投票

### In-Game Timeline Editor游戏时间轴编辑器

Press **F6** in-game to open the built-in timeline editor:在游戏中按**F6**打开内置的时间轴编辑器：

- 4-area layout: menu bar, property panel, 16:9 preview viewport, multi-track timeline
- Full CRUD on clips and keyframes — drag, resize, snap
- Trigger editor with auto-complete from game registries触发编辑器与自动完成从游戏注册表
- FBO-based viewport preview-基于fbo的视窗预览

---

## Getting Started

1. Install **Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 (47.x+)**
2. Drop the jar into `.minecraft/mods/`
3. Launch the game

### Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/icinematics play <file>` | Play a cinematic script |
| `/icinematics stop` | Stop current playback |
| `/icinematics status` | Show playback status |
